hiw.hero_title: Built By Students: Why MatchMax Works Better
hiw.hero_body: MatchMax was founded by recent IB and DSE graduates to fix a broken system. Traditional agencies take massive cuts, driving up costs for families and underpaying educators. We believe that when an agency takes less, everyone wins. By strictly limiting our commission to just the first one and a half lessons, we make elite tutoring more accessible for parents and significantly more rewarding for tutors. As a high-touch concierge, we also personally manage your onboarding and your first 2 lessons, then step back and leave parents and tutors to run the ongoing schedule directly. When you use MatchMax, you aren't just finding a tutor—you are directly supporting dedicated educators in a fairer, transparent community.
hiw.compare_edu_title: For Tutors: Fair Rules, Built by Students Who Understand You
hiw.compare_parent_title: For Parents: Real Scores, Verified Credentials

commission.old: Take 2 full weeks of your pay (up to 4–8 lessons).
commission.detail: You only pay for 1.5 lessons per successful match. You keep 100% of everything you earn after that.

travel.old: Assign cases by broad districts, making you travel an hour for a single lesson.
travel.detail: You pick the exact MTR stations you can reach. We only send you students along your line.

credibility.old: Squash your achievements into generic bullet points that make top scorers blend in with average applicants.
credibility.detail: Showcase your exact strengths—including 7s in specific HL subjects, IA scores, and 5** paper breakdowns—so parents see your real value.

voice.old: Run by corporate agents who never took your syllabus and do not care about your study schedule.
voice.detail: We understand university workloads, exam stress, and what your prep time is worth.

privacy.old: Blast full names, phone numbers, or school affiliations across public groups.
privacy.detail: Full names and sensitive personal details remain private. Tutors and school teachers alike can instruct safely without public exposure.

browsing.old: Cluttered, messy profiles that are painful to navigate. Crucial details are hidden away or missing, making direct comparison impossible.
browsing.detail: Key credentials—verified scores, secondary schools, and target subjects—are visible right on the preview card. Browse, compare, and shortlist tutors effortlessly like online shopping, with no lost profiles.

screening.old: Anyone can sign up. They rarely verify if reported grades or degrees are genuine.
screening.detail: We manually check official transcripts, diplomas, and exam certificates before an tutor profile goes live.

quality.old: Accept average scorers just to fill slots and collect a booking cut.
quality.detail: Every tutor must clear our minimum academic bar (such as IB 40+, DSE 30+, or A*AA).

scores.old: Give you a vague one-line summary about the tutor's background.
scores.detail: See exact component marks for IAs, essays, and individual exam papers before you choose.

alumni.old: Pair your child with random tutors who do not know their school's curriculum style.
alumni.detail: Find tutors who graduated from your child's exact secondary school or study their target degree.

paid.q: How much is the MatchMax commission?
paid.a: MatchMax is entirely free to join. For standard, ongoing tutoring cases, we charge a one-time administrative fee equivalent to your first 1.5 lessons. You keep 100% of your earnings for every lesson after that. For Short-Term Cases: If a parent explicitly requests a short-term assignment (defined as 5 lessons or fewer), our fee is automatically adjusted to just 20% of the total assignment value, so you always retain an 80% majority cut.

anonymity.q: Will my name and photo be publicly visible on Google?
anonymity.a: No. MatchMax respects the privacy of our top scholars and university students. Your public directory profile is completely anonymous and focuses solely on your academic achievements. Furthermore, our concierge team will only ever introduce you to parents using your last name (e.g., “Tutor Chan”). You have complete control over sharing your full name once your lessons begin.

speed.q: How many days does it usually take to find students?
speed.a: Matching speed depends on subject demand, your profile quality, and availability. Many tutors receive relevant student matching requests within 1 to 2 weeks.

rates.a: Usual market rates typically range between HK$300 to HK$600 per hour. However, rates vary depending on lesson mode (online vs. in-person), duration, level, subject complexity, and your academic background. Tutors can discuss and negotiate rates directly with parents to agree on a fair fee.

experience.q: Do I need teaching experience to join?
experience.a: Prior experience helps, but strong academic results, clear communication skills, and a complete profile are equally important for verification and student matching.

modes.q: Can I teach both online and in person?
modes.a: Yes. You can set your preferred lesson modes and target locations in your profile and update them anytime as your schedule changes.

after_trial.q: How do payments work after the trial lessons?
after_trial.a: To give you full financial control and ensure you keep 100% of your earnings, all ongoing lesson fees are paid directly from the parent to you using your preferred method. Because you manage your own ongoing schedule and billing, we recommend collecting payment on a lesson-by-lesson basis or upfront for the month. If a payment issue ever arises, you can report it to our team; while we do not act as a collection agency, we take community safety seriously and will restrict non-paying users from future matching.

negotiate.a: Yes, rates can be negotiated, but any adjustments depend entirely on the tutor's willingness and policy. Factors such as lesson frequency, online vs. in-person mode, travel distance, and lesson length may give room for discussion directly with the tutor.

trial.q: Can I arrange a trial lesson before committing to a regular schedule?
trial.a: Yes. Parents are welcome to request an initial single trial lesson. Whether a trial lesson is offered and its specific terms (paid or discounted) depend entirely on the individual tutor's willingness and policy, which you can confirm directly before starting.

matching.a: You have two straightforward options: you can click forward directly on any tutor's profile card to request that specific tutor, or reach out to our WhatsApp hotline and tell us exactly what you are looking for so we can match you. Once confirmed, we connect you directly with the tutor to finalize lesson times.

anonymity.q: Why don't I see the tutors' full names on their profiles?
anonymity.a: To attract the highest tier of university scholars and official examiners—many of whom require strict privacy and prefer not to have their tutoring profiles publicly searchable—MatchMax utilizes anonymous profiles (e.g., “MM-T104”). Once you request a specific profile, our concierge team will introduce you to your match using their professional title and last name (e.g., “Tutor Chan” or “Miss Lee”) to arrange the trial lesson.

involvement.q: How long does MatchMax stay involved in our tutoring arrangement?
involvement.a: MatchMax operates as a high-touch concierge matching service. We actively oversee your onboarding, ensure your trial lesson goes smoothly, and manage the communication for your first 2 lessons until the administrative matching fee is settled. Once this initial matching phase is successfully completed, MatchMax steps back, leaving parents and tutors to manage their ongoing schedule directly.

verification.q: How does MatchMax verify tutor qualifications and grades?
verification.a: MatchMax uses a two-tier system. Tier 1 tutors list self-reported results as “Stated Qualifications”—MatchMax does not cryptographically verify these claims, so you can request photographic proof directly from the tutor before the first lesson. Tier 2 tutors carry the blue Verified Scholar Badge, meaning our team has manually checked their identity and academic documents. Either way, you can always ask for proof before committing.

payments.q: How do payments work between parents and tutors?
payments.a: Tuition is paid directly to the tutor based on the agreed hourly rate and schedule. MatchMax does not hold or handle your tuition fees, keeping the payment process direct and transparent.

pay.q: How and when do I pay for the lessons?
pay.a: To keep the process simple and secure, MatchMax charges our one-time administrative matching fee directly to us via FPS within 24 hours after a successful trial lesson. For standard ongoing cases, this fee is equivalent to the cost of 1.5 lessons. For short-term assignments (5 lessons or fewer), the fee is strictly 20% of the total scheduled package. After this initial matching fee is settled, you pay your tutor directly for all remaining lessons.

rematch.q: What if the tutor isn't a good fit after the first lesson?
rematch.a: We offer a First-Lesson Free Rematch Guarantee. If you feel the tutor is not the perfect match for your child, simply compensate the tutor directly for that single hour of teaching, and MatchMax will immediately waive our administrative fee to personally hand-select a new, better-suited candidate for you at no additional platform cost.

reschedule.q: What happens if my child is sick or we need to reschedule?
reschedule.a: We understand that schedules change and emergencies happen. We simply ask that parents and tutors communicate directly in your dedicated MatchMax WhatsApp group and aim to provide at least 24 hours' notice out of mutual respect.

account.q: Do I need to create an account to request a tutor?
account.a: No. You can request a tutor directly through our website as a guest, and our concierge team will handle the matching process personally via WhatsApp.

notes.q: How do purchases of digital study materials work?
notes.a: Study materials are sold through the MatchMax escrow. You pay the full amount to the MatchMax official business account via FPS, and we hold the payment until the file is delivered before the tutor receives their 80% share on the 1st of the following month (MatchMax retains a 20% platform commission). Because digital files cannot be returned, all sales are final—please review the free watermarked preview before purchasing.
